summary: community.vmware's vmware_guest_tools_info will drop vm_tools_install_status in 5.0.0 because the VMware API is deprecated; use vm_tools_running_status or vm_tools_version_status.
questions: vm_tools_install_status is deprecated, what should I check instead?
How do I check if VMware Tools is running with vmware_guest_tools_info?

answer_card.title: vmware_guest_tools_info: vm_tools_install_status removed
answer_card.answer_md: `vmware_guest_tools_info` will drop **`vm_tools_install_status`** in community.vmware **5.0.0**. Use **`vm_tools_running_status`** or **`vm_tools_version_status`** instead.
